body:
Root cause of the 404 the founder hit after deploying: two earlier deploys today never actually restarted the live idunapro process (running since 20:50:35), so all backend changes since then were invisible despite clean builds. Fixed the script to explicitly restart; manually restarted the live service to pick up current code. Commit 80fe071.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix: 51-carepyre-console-idunapro-deploy.sh now actually restarts idunapro (enable --now doesn't restart a running service)
